The '''Dargullans''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dargul]]. The Dargullans were ruled by a noble class, headed by a [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]].<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
